title: Drift Wood #25 · Thanksgiving, again
logline: The survey, second year. Wood has revised his answer. Chloe's line is still blank.

panels.composition: The newsroom. CHLOE with the clipboard. Same poster, one year more faded.

balloons.text: Maple bars. And the new tide tables.

image.prompt: a teenage girl with a clipboard in a school newsroom under a faded hand-lettered poster, a boy in a backwards cap answering

panels.composition: Wood, prepared this time. A single index card.

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat holding up a single index card, prepared

panels.composition: The card, in his hand: one word, crossed out, another word, crossed out, and a third. Chloe reading it.

image.prompt: close-up of an index card with two words crossed out and a third written small, a girl's eyes reading it

panels.composition: The pasted-up column: GULLIVER — maple bars, tide tables. FINCH — (a word too small to read at this size). STERLING — blank again.
panels.caption: THANKFUL FOR — THE TIMBERLINE ASKS, YEAR TWO

image.prompt: a pasted-up newspaper survey column of names and answers, one answer too small to read, one line blank, xerox grain
image.notes: Wood's third word is illegible on purpose. The reader who enlarges the print edition finds nothing; it's drawn as a scribble.

notes: Wood's answer is illegible on purpose. Chloe's is blank again.
